patterns.message: ARCHITECTURE.md 8.5 / 13.2 - `shared` has no root barrel. Import the concept: @shared/tag, @shared/empty-state, @shared/calendar.

ARCHITECTURE.md 13.2 - a core concern's barrel is its only entry point. Import @core/<concern>, never its services/ implementation files. The only sanctioned deep buckets are @core/api/models and @core/api/utils.
ARCHITECTURE.md 13.2 - `ui/pages/` is internal-only and has no public barrel. A page is a route entry; nothing imports it.

ARCHITECTURE.md 4 - `core` must never depend on `features` or `layouts`. The one sanctioned inversion is a core-owned port that a feature implements and binds (section 5.6): define the port in core, let the feature bind the token.

ARCHITECTURE.md 4 / 8.5 - `shared` must not import feature state, services, models, or UI. The only feature code it may consume is a published port (interface + token) from the owning feature's ports/ barrel.
ARCHITECTURE.md 8.5 - `shared` must not import a layout. Slot-contribution providers that import a layout belong to the layout, not to shared.
ARCHITECTURE.md 4 / 8.2 - a layout must not inject a concrete feature store or data-access service. Consume a published port instead, or receive the widget through a slot contribution.

ARCHITECTURE.md 4 / 14.2 - onboarding may consume exactly four organization surfaces, and they are the ones its FEATURE.md records: setup, models, data-access, and the equipments public API. Anything deeper is a private path. This rule mirrors the documented contract - widen the FEATURE.md first, then this list.

ARCHITECTURE.md 4 / 14.2 - interventions may consume collaboration only through its published ui/components barrel (SubjectDiscussion), the surface collaboration's FEATURE.md records for this dependency. Anything deeper is a private path. This rule mirrors the documented contract - widen the FEATURE.md first, then this list.
ARCHITECTURE.md 8.5 / 13.2 - `shared` has no root barrel. Import the concept: @shared/tag, @shared/empty-state, @shared/calendar.

ARCHITECTURE.md 13.2 - a core concern's barrel is its only entry point. Import @core/<concern>, never its services/ implementation files. The only sanctioned deep buckets are @core/api/models and @core/api/utils.
ARCHITECTURE.md 13.2 - `ui/pages/` is internal-only and has no public barrel. A page is a route entry; nothing imports it.

ARCHITECTURE.md 4 / 14.2 - the assets explorer may consume the facilities subfeature only through its state barrel (FacilityTreeStore), models (FacilityOutput) and utils (facilityToTreeNode), the surfaces facilities/FEATURE.md records for this dependency. Anything deeper is a private path. This rule mirrors the documented contract - widen the FEATURE.md first, then this list.

ARCHITECTURE.md 4 / 14.2 - the assets explorer may consume the equipments subfeature only through its data-access and models barrels (EquipmentService, EquipmentOutput), the surfaces organization/FEATURE.md records for this dependency. Anything deeper is a private path. This rule mirrors the documented contract - widen the FEATURE.md first, then this list.
